import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_students.head())
    # print(df_schools.head())
    
    # The target schema is:
    # ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str,
    #  'school_name': str, 'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int,
    #  'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]
    #
    # Source0 has student info + scores but no school metadata (School ID, type, size, budget)
    # Source1 has school metadata keyed by School ID and school_name
    #
    # Join condition:
    # Join df_students.school_name == df_schools.school_name to get school metadata for each student.
    #
    # Note: Source0 does NOT have School ID column, so we join on school_name.
    # After join, we will have all columns needed.
    #
    # Data types will be enforced after join.
    
    # Merge on 'school_name' to bring school metadata to student records
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on='school_name', how='left', validate='many_to_one')
    
    # Rename columns if needed to match target schema exactly
    # Columns from df_students: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score']
    # Columns from df_schools: ['School ID', 'school_name', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    # After merge, columns: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    # This matches target schema column names exactly.
    
    # Enforce data types according to target schema
    df_merged = df_merged.astype({
        'Student ID': 'int64',
        'student_name': 'string',
        'gender': 'string',
        'grade': 'string',
        'school_name': 'string',
        'reading_score': 'Int64',  # Use nullable integer dtype to allow missing values if any
        'math_score': 'Int64',
        'School ID': 'Int64',
        'type': 'string',
        'size': 'Int64',
        'budget': 'Int64'
    })
    
    # Optional: reorder columns to match target schema order exactly
    target_columns = ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
                      'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_final = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Write the result to the specified path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
